title: Moonlight Oath

outfit_card.silhouette: Floor-length column gown in sheer layered silk chiffon, fitted empire bodice, flowing integrated cape veil, asymmetric front slit, and draped shoulder panels.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Sheer white lace veil bonnet with scalloped edges, cascading wide lace trim, and a delicate gilded circlet of thin stars.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Pale aqua empire bodice with cowl neckline, fine gold armlets and celestial beadwork, draped sheer organza sleeve panels falling from the shoulder veil.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Bias-cut layered chiffon skirt, deep blue-to-cyan gradient, sparsely scattered gold star embroidery, front split showing a second sheer petticoat, and silver heeled sandals.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Scattered floating silver stars and tiny glowing spheres, a large star motif on the skirt, and a translucent white veil trailing from the headpiece.
